guidance.eligibilityNarrative: VA-guaranteed purchase path for eligible veterans/service members where entitlement, occupancy, residual-income, and property conditions satisfy current VA policy and lender overlays.
keyRequirements: Certificate of Eligibility (COE) and entitlement verification.
Primary occupancy intent and property eligibility.
Residual income and DTI review under VA standards and investor overlays.
documentationExpectations: COE and service documentation as required.
Residual income worksheet with regional family-size factors.
edgeCases: Tier-two entitlement and county guaranty interactions.
Condo project approval and property-condition repairs.
commonDenialReasons: Ineligible occupancy or property condition issues.
Overlay credit/DTI restrictions exceed baseline VA tolerance.
overlayCaveats: Many investors impose minimum FICO overlays for VA loans.
Manual-underwrite paths often face tighter DTI and reserve overlays.
compensatingFactors: Verified reserves and stable housing payment profile.
workflowNotes: Order COE and confirm entitlement early in intake.
Track funding fee/exemption evidence before closing docs.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: VA IRRRL streamline path for existing VA borrowers with required net tangible benefit and seasoning/payment-history controls.
keyRequirements: Existing VA loan and eligible seasoning/payment history.
Net tangible benefit documentation and recoupment limits.
Occupancy certification and fee policy compliance.
documentationExpectations: VA IRRRL NTB and recoupment worksheet.
Funding fee treatment and exemption confirmation.
edgeCases: Loan payoff timing issues affecting recoupment.
commonDenialReasons: Overlay-specific DTI or credit minimum shortfall.
overlayCaveats: Some investors layer stricter payment-history windows.
Credit overlays may apply despite streamline concept.
compensatingFactors: Strong current payment history with clear savings.
Low risk-profile changes and stable occupancy.
workflowNotes: Validate NTB early before locking terms.
Confirm payoff timing and escrows for recoupment test.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: VA cash-out path requiring full income/asset/credit qualification, occupancy compliance, and lender overlay review.
keyRequirements: Cash-out purpose must be policy compliant with documented proceeds use.
Full underwrite including income, assets, and liabilities.
Residual-income and DTI must satisfy policy/overlay thresholds.
documentationExpectations: Full income and asset verification package.
Residual-income worksheet and VA fee category support.
edgeCases: High LTV with thin residual-income margin.
Overlay cash-out LTV caps by investor.
commonDenialReasons: Residual income or DTI outside investor tolerance.
overlayCaveats: Cash-out programs frequently have tighter investor overlays than purchase/IRRRL.
Manual underwrite often triggers stricter reserve expectations.
compensatingFactors: Conservative use-of-proceeds with low layered risk.
workflowNotes: Document payoff and cash disbursement trail clearly.
Escalate overlay exceptions before final underwriting.
